description: This file contains cryptographic utility classes for session management and password generation in PHP. It includes classes MD5Crypt and SHA1Crypt with methods for encrypting, decrypting, and generating random passwords, utilizing MD5 and SHA1 hashing algorithms respectively.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: Class providing methods for MD5-based encryption, decryption, and random password generation.

classes.name: SHA1Crypt
classes.description: Class providing methods for SHA1-based encryption, decryption, and random password generation.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Performs XOR encryption or decryption on a string using a hashed key, used internally by both classes.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string with a key, returning a base64-encoded result suitable for secure storage or transmission.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted string with a key, reversing the encryption process.

methods.name: RandPass
methods.description: Generates an 8-character random password consisting of alphanumeric characters.
